item.title: Plateau Attack: Death toll rises to 19
item.description: By Golok Nanmwa JOS — The death toll from an attack on Tafi-Gana (Cando Zrreci), a community in Jebbu Miango, Bassa Local Government Area of Plateau State, has risen to 19 following the death of three persons who were rushed to hospital after the incident. The attack reportedly occurred on Wednesday night, November 25, and continued into the early hours of Thursday, November 26, 2026, throwing the community into confusion, fear and panic. A resident of the community, Moses Monday, who confirmed the casualty figure on Thursday, said 16 bodies were recovered at the scene, while three other victims died after being taken to hospital. Monday said: “This is evil. I can confirm that 16 bodies have so far been recovered at the spot, with an additional three who died after they were taken to the hospital. These evil men will not rest.” Another resident, Nuhu Fidelis, who also confirmed the attack, described it as another assault on a neighbouring community in Jebbu Miango. Fidelis said: “Yes, in the early morning of today, Thursday. Last night, November 25, 2026, a Christian neighbouring village, Tafi-Gana (Cando Zrreci), in Jebbu Miango, Bassa LGA, Plateau State, was attacked again. Many innocent people lost their lives.” He condemned the killings and called on the government and security agencies to take urgent measures to protect residents. Another resident, Paul Nehemiah, who said he lost a close relative in the attack, described the killings as wicked and unprovoked, adding that residents had been living in fear following repeated attacks. Nehemiah said: “We are tired of burying our people. These are farmers, women and children who did nothing to anyone. How long will this continue? We are calling on the government to rise up and save us.” Rita Joseph, whose family fled the village during the attack, said community members could no longer sleep peacefully because of persistent security threats. She said: “We ran into the bush with our children.” The residents appealed to the Plateau State Government, the Federal Government and security agencies to deploy more personnel to Miango and surrounding communities to prevent further attacks. They also urged the authorities to take decisive action to bring the perpetrators to justice and restore confidence among residents. Efforts to obtain comments from the Plateau State Police Command spokesman, SP Alfred Alabo, and his counterpart at Operation Enduring Peace, Captain Polycarp Chinonso Oteh, were unsuccessful, as they had yet to respond to inquiries by our correspondent as of the time of filing this report. The post Plateau Attack: Death toll rises to 19 appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Gov Bago Receives Report On 37 Miners Deaths, Pledges Full Implementation Of Recommendations
item.description: ‎Niger State Governor, Umaru Bago, has received the report of the Judicial Commission of Inquiry established to investigate the circumstances surrounding the deaths of 37 artisanal miners while in the custody of the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps (NSCDC), Niger State Command. ‎The Governor received the report from the Chairman of the Commission, Justice Muhammad Muhammad, at the Government House, Minna, where he reaffirmed his administration’s commitment to implementing its recommendations. ‎Governor Bago expressed appreciation to the Commission on behalf of the bereaved families, the Miners Association and the NSCDC, describing the report as an important document that would guide stakeholders in addressing the circumstances surrounding the tragic incident. ‎He commended Justice Muhammad and members of the Commission for their dedication, sacrifices and thoroughness throughout the investigation, assuring that the government would carefully consider the findings and recommendations. ‎The Governor also disclosed that a copy of the report would be forwarded to the Presidency for reference, underscoring the importance of the investigation and its outcome. ‎Earlier, the Chairman of the Commission, Justice Muhammad Muhammad, thanked the Governor for the confidence reposed in the panel and the opportunity to serve. ‎He explained that the Commission received nine memoranda, conducted public hearings and carried out inspection visits to two mining sites, two NSCDC offices and the General Hospital in Minna as part of its investigation. ‎Justice Muhammad said the evidence and facts gathered during the proceedings formed the basis of the Commission’s findings and recommendations. ‎He further explained that the report was presented in three volumes for ease of reference, with Volume One containing the findings, observations and recommendations; Volume Two containing the records of proceedings; and Volume Three comprising all exhibits tendered before the Commission. ‎In his remarks, the Attorney General and Commissioner for Justice, Nasiru Mu’azu, described the deaths of the 37 artisanal miners as a grave incident in the history of Niger State. ‎He commended Governor Bago for demonstrating commitment to the rule of law by establishing the Judicial Commission of Inquiry to investigate the incident and ensure that the circumstances surrounding the deaths were thoroughly examined. ‎Mu’azu assured that the Ministry of Justice would carefully study the report and advise the government on appropriate actions and the next steps to be taken. ‎ ‎ The post Gov Bago Receives Report On 37 Miners Deaths, Pledges Full Implementation Of Recommendations appeared first on Channels Television .

item.title: Company was religious about backups but sinned by leaving them exposed
item.description: Welcome, once again, to PWNED, where we’re thankful every time someone leaves a password sticky note on a monitor or fails to delete a terminated employee’s admin account. But neither of those common occurrences is what we’ll be talking about today. Instead, our subject broke the number-one rule of backups: you gotta keep ’em separated. Our story comes courtesy of Da Li, who serves as global alliance manager at Info2Soft , a company that provides data protection and recovery software. At one point, a partner called him into a case where a Chinese vehicle parts manufacturer fell victim to a ransomware gang. Unfortunately, its backup was compromised too. The manufacturer had religiously backed up its manufacturing execution system (MES) and SAP orders, inventory, and finance systems every night. There was even a green dashboard that showed the backup process had succeeded, and someone checked that every morning. However, one Friday evening, crims broke into the network and found out that the backup server was joined to the same Windows domain as the rest of the network. The hackers found a plaintext password for the backup service account in a maintenance script on a file share and discovered that someone had used the very same password for a domain admin account. So the first thing the crooks did was delete every restore point on that backup server. Then they started encrypting the production servers to ransom them. “Every backup job had succeeded for three years,” Li said. “The failure was that the thing meant to save them could be reached with the same keys as the thing being attacked.” The results were devastating. With the MES and SAP data both gone, the plant couldn't schedule production, ship parts, or track them. By the time Li was called in, the plant had already resolved its ransomware situation. We don’t know whether it paid or not. The manufacturer did ask Li and his company to make sure that this couldn’t happen again. Li’s fix was not radical, but it was instructive. He made sure that the company now keeps its backup system outside the production domain, uses unique credentials, and requires MFA to reduce the risk of unauthorized access even if a password is compromised. He also made sure that the company keeps at least one offline backup and runs a test restore quarterly to ensure it’s prepared for emergencies.®

item.title: UHSAA associate director Jeff Cluff, 49, dies from complications from stroke
item.description: Jeff Cluff, UHSAA associate director Jeff Cluff, who spent the past 12 years as a director with the UHSAA and was a champion of the mission of high school athletics, passed away at t. George Regional Hospital late Wednesday evening surrounded by family after complications from a stroke. He was 49. Cluff suffered a stroke last year Thursday, and after the family updated his condition on social media Saturday, they received an outpouring of love and support from the thousands and thousands of people in the athletics community who Cluff impacted. UHSAA associate director Jeff Cluff presents the state championship trophy to Corner Canyon after winning the 6A girls volleyball state championship against Skyridge at the UCCU Center at Utah Valley University in Orem on Thursday, Oct. 30, 2025. | Tess Crowley, Deseret News Cluff joined the UHSAA in 2014 as the supervisor of officials. During his time with the UHSAA, he’s also served as the director of baseball, along with overseeing compliance and eligibility, media services, arbiter sports, website administration, ticketing operations and numerous other roles. Prior to that he worked 13 years in the Dixie State University (now utah Tech) athletics department. Here’s the official family statement through social media on Thursday morning. View this post on Instagram “It is with profound sadness that we announce the death of our beloved husband, father, brother, son and friend, Jeff cluff, 49, following complications from a stroke. Jeff died late Wednesday evening surrounded by loved ones. Born in Tooele, Utah, jeff built a life centered on faith, family, friendship and service to others. He had a remarkable ability to make everyone he encountered fell like the most important person in the room. He was genuine, fiercely loyal, quick-witted and unapologetically himself. He told you what you needed to hear, stood by you when it mattered most and was always looking for ways to help others. These were values he and Monica worked to instill in their children, because raising a good family was his life’s mission. Whether on a the baseball field, among friends or at home with his family, Jeff lived with integrity, kindness and a deep sense of fairness. Those who knew him as an umpire knew the same man we knew at home: honest, consistent, firm in his convictions and kind at heart. Jeff’s generosity extended far beyond those closest to him, and in keeping with his lifelong commitment to helping others, Jeff’s final act of generosity was to give the gift of life through organ donation, hopefully blessing the lives of others as he did ours. While our hearts are broken, we find comfort in our faith, the memories we share adn the extraordinary outpouring of love from the community. Hearing the countless stories of how Jeff touched the lives of others has been a tremendous source of strength for our family. The greatest tribute anyone could offer Jeff is to carry forward the qualities that defined him: show up for others

item.title: “RIZE Up Day” aims to empower Western PA middle schoolers
item.description: WPXI Approximately 200 middle school students from the Aliquippa and Shaler Area school districts gathered at the RIZE Sports Complex in Leetsdale on Tuesday for “RIZE Up Day.” The four-hour program engaged sixth-, seventh- and eighth-grade students in sports training, health workshops and career exploration. Organized by the Boys & Girls Clubs of Western Pennsylvania and hosted by RIZE Sports, the event took place at 1201 Brickworks Dr. Program organizers structured the day to help young people build confidence, maintain active lifestyles and learn about career opportunities in the sports and wellness industries. Chuck Cooper III addressed the students as the keynote speaker following opening remarks. Cooper is the president and chief executive officer of the Chuck Cooper Foundation. He is the son of Charles “Chuck” Cooper, the Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame member who became the first African American drafted into the NBA. Participants took part in physical training spread across three activity rotations. Community coaches from the Cleveland Cavaliers directed basketball skills sessions, while players from the University of Pittsburgh women’s lacrosse team led agility and conditioning drills. Beyond athletics, the morning incorporated wellness and emergency response education. Representatives from the Children’s Institute of Pittsburgh guided students through mindfulness and yoga rotations. In a separate hands-on session, instructors from the American Heart Association provided students with foundational CPR training to teach basic life-saving skills. During lunch sessions, students attended a panel discussion focused on professional careers in sports. Jim Britt, executive director of SportsPITTSBURGH, served as moderator. The panel featured Rachel Brecht, chief people officer of the Pittsburgh Penguins; Ethan Lounsbury, senior director of marketing for the Pittsburgh Riverhounds; and Benjamin Moore, senior sports marketing manager at F.N.B. item.title: Tinubu housing projects deliver over 26,000 units, 525,100 jobs, APC-PCC says
item.description: …As MOFI implements N1 trillion mortgage programme By Omeiza Ajayi ABUJA: The All Progressives Congress Presidential Campaign Council APC-PCC said on Thursday thst the President Bola Tinubu administration has facilitated the financing and delivery of over 26,000 housing units and generated 525,100 real estate construction jobs nationwide in the past three years. Spokesperson of the council, Dele Alake, made the claim in a statement issued in Abuja. According to the statement, the Ministry of Finance Incorporated MOFI, through the MOFI Real Estate Investment Fund (MREIF), has provided more than N158 billion in mortgage financing to 2,269 homebuyers as of October 31, 2026. The statement said the fund financed properties valued at more than N279 billion, while 695 housing units have received offtake guarantees, “creating a ready market for private-sector property development”. It said 6,620 properties have been listed on the fund’s platform, with 21 financial institutions providing mortgage services across 28 states and all six geopolitical zones. MREIF, a N1 trillion housing finance programme sponsored by MOFI, commenced operations on March 17, 2025, to expand access to affordable mortgages and mobilise private investment in the housing sector. The statement said beneficiaries can access mortgage loans at an interest rate of 9.75 per cent per annum, with repayment periods of up to 20 years and a minimum equity contribution of 10 per cent. It added that the fund raised an initial N250 billion, made up of N150 billion in concessionary Federal Government funding and N100 billion in private commercial investment. “To enable more Nigerians to own homes, President Tinubu’s administration recognises that affordable mortgage loans, reasonably priced developer financing, and local production of building materials are crucial to reducing housing costs and expanding construction activities,” the statement said. On construction, the council said the Federal Ministry of Housing and Urban Development is building 10,328 housing units at different stages of completion under the Renewed Hope Cities and Estates Programme. These include 2,744 units at the Renewed Hope City in Abuja, 2,000 in Kano and 2,084 in Lagos, while another 3,500 units are being developed under the Renewed Hope Estates Programme across 14 states. The Federal Housing Authority FHA, it said, is delivering 3,341 units, including 1,550 units for armed forces personnel in Jabi, Abuja. The Federal Mortgage Bank of Nigeria FMBN accounts for another 11,294 housing units, comprising 9,076 units financed between 2024 and 2025 and 2,218 units delivered in the first quarter of 2026. According to the statement, the ministry’s housing projects are estimated to have generated 258,200 employment opportunities, while FMBN’s interventions have generated 226,900. item.title: Pep Guardiola says how Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo’s rivalry worked
item.description: Pep Guardiola says how Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo’s rivalry worked appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Regarded as two of the greatest soccer players of the modern generation, Argentina’s Lionel Messi and Portugal’s Cristiano Ronaldo shared one of the most intense soccer rivalries. While Messi represented FC Barcelona, Ronaldo was a main player of their rival team, Real Madrid. Former FC Barcelona manager Pep Guardiola believes that Ronaldo and Messi would not have enjoyed such long and dominant careers without each other. Messi and Ronaldo faced each other multiple times while representing Real Madrid and Barcelona, respectively, and even captained their national team at this year’s FIFA World Cup despite being in the twilight of their careers. However, both men have now retired from international soccer. Recently, speaking on RomárioTV, Guardiola shared his thoughts on their rivalry . “I think the two of them helped each other a great deal, if Messi hadn’t had Cristiano, or if Cristiano hadn’t had Messi, their careers would likely have been shorter. But they had each other in their rearview mirrors, watching what the other was doing made them think: ‘I want to be better than him, I want to win more than him.'” (via ESPN) Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Ronaldo, 41, retired from Portugal as the leading men’s international goal scorer with 146 goals in 234 games. He was recently also awarded the Ballon d’Or of All-Time . Ronaldo also recently scored his 987th career goal. On the other hand, Messi currently captains Inter Miami in MLS and retired with 126 goals for Argentina in 206 games . Ronaldo and Messi’s rivalry dominated soccer for over a decade, and the duo has a total of 13 combined Ballon d’Ors. item.title: FIFA confirms cyberattack, says hackers stole personal, business data
item.description: By Adegboyega Adeleye FIFA has confirmed a criminal cyberattack that exposed a limited amount of personal and business information, while files linked to its abandoned World Cup stake-sale plan were not accessed. According to Reuters, a person with direct knowledge of the incident said less than 0.1 per cent of FIFA’s total data was affected and no files from the FIFA Forward Enterprise project were accessed. “FIFA can confirm that it has been the victim of a criminal cyberattack resulting in unauthorised access to a limited set of personal and business information,” a FIFA spokesperson told Reuters. The football governing body condemned the unlawful acquisition and publication of information, particularly personal data, calling it “a serious and unacceptable violation of privacy”. FIFA did not disclose when the attack took place, how many people or organisations were affected, or what business information was accessed. It also did not say whether any data had appeared online or where it may have been published. FIFA scrapped plans in July to sell private investors a stake in a new unit that would manage its events, including the World Cup. The proposal aimed to raise up to $4.2 billion by selling a 20 per cent stake. The post FIFA confirms cyberattack, says hackers stole personal, business data appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Germany's Freigang to miss women's World Cup due do doping ban
item.description: FILE PHOTO - Germany's Laura Freigang pictured during a training Session Open to the Media Ahead of World Cup Qualifier. (is associated with: «Germany's Freigang to miss women's World Cup due do doping ban») Marc Schüler/dpa Germany national team player Laura Freigang will miss next year's women's World Cup in Brazil after she's been suspended for missing doping tests, the German Football Federation (DFB) said in a statement on Thursday. Freigang will be suspended until October 7, 2027 after she reached a settlement with the DFB, the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) and Germany's National Anti-Doping Agency (NADA). Proceedings against Freigang had been ongoing for months. The 28-year-old was accused of not being at the location she specified for a doping control on three occasions between March 2025 and February 2026. In June, the Eintracht Frankfurt captain explained that the missed tests "were not deliberately avoided appointments but inconsistencies or misunderstandings in the comprehensive details that have to be updated daily and which we as national team players have to update in the system on a daily and hourly basis." Freigang has 45 caps for Germany and has scored 17 goals, but hasn't been a regular starter recently.

item.title: As Nigeria Rethinks Teacher Education, Tunji Olowolafe Makes a Case for Better-Prepared Educators
item.description: What makes a good teacher? Beyond knowing a subject, a good teacher can understand students, inspire confidence, and help young people discover what they are capable of becoming. It was this broader responsibility of educators that Dr. Tunji Olowolafe explored while delivering the 2026 Convocation Lecture at the Sikiru Adetona College of Education, Science and Technology (SACOETEC), Omu-Ajose, Ogun State. Speaking on Monday, 23 November 2026, on the theme “The Dual-Mandate NCE-Degree Programme: Prospects, Challenges and the Future of Teacher Education in Nigeria,” he described the programme as an important opportunity to reposition teacher education. For decades, Colleges of Education depended on university affiliations to award Bachelor’s degrees, despite many possessing the academic capacity to run such programmes. The Federal Colleges of Education Act 2023 changed this, empowering eligible institutions to award degrees independently. Under the Dual-Mandate programme, students can complete three years of NCE training and proceed to another two years for a Bachelor’s degree in Education. Dr. Olowolafe explained that combining practical teaching skills with deeper academic knowledge would produce better-prepared educators. However, he cautioned that institutional autonomy must be supported by sustained funding, improved curricula and professional development. With Nigeria facing an estimated shortage of one million teachers, he also called for greater integration of vocational education, artificial intelligence and digital skills into learning. “AI can explain a quadratic equation at midnight, but it cannot offer the steady, empathetic guidance of a caring adult,” he said, emphasizing that artificial intelligence must complement, not replace, the human qualities of effective teaching. During the lecture, Dr. Olowolafe announced that the Tunji Olowolafe Foundation would establish a fully equipped, solar-powered Gbemisola Olowolafe Memorial ICT Centre (GOMTECH) with high-speed internet connectivity at SACOETEC. The Foundation is also committed to recognising academic excellence and outstanding teaching at the College. This includes recognising the College’s first-class degree graduates and NCE distinction holders, alongside the overall best NCE and degree graduates. Lecturers, selected based on student ratings, will also be honoured for their teaching contributions. The initiative builds on the Foundation’s existing investment in education, including Project Digi-Teach at Ekiti State University and GOMTECH in Are-Ekiti. For Dr. Olowolafe, the commitment to educators is also deeply personal. His mother was a teacher, his elder sister taught for years at Baptist Academy, Lagos, and his late wife, Gbemisola Olowolafe, was a lifelong educator. He recalled the influence of teachers who shaped his own experience, particularly Mr. Soewu of Methodist Boys’ High School , whose patience helped students understand difficult concepts without humiliation. item.title: Meet Nigeria’s Damilola Bolarinde, crowned Miss International Africa 2026
item.description: By Enitan Abdultawab Nigerian beauty queen Damilola Bolarinde has been crowned Miss International Africa 2026 after representing the country at the 64th edition of the Miss International pageant in Tokyo, Japan. The continental title was announced on Thursday, November 26, a day after the grand finale held on November 25, which featured 73 contestants from different countries. Bolarinde, popularly known as Queen Dammy, secured a place among the Top 20 contestants but did not advance to the Top 10. Her performance at the competition earned her the Miss International Africa title. The achievement adds to her growing profile in the Nigerian beauty pageant industry, having represented Lagos State at the 2025 Miss Universe Nigeria competition, where she emerged first runner-up behind Anambra State representative, Onyinyechi Basil. In April 2026, Bolarinde won the Face of Hope pageant, earning the right to represent Nigeria at the Miss International competition as Miss International Nigeria 2026. She defeated contestants representing Anambra and Rivers states, who finished as first and second runners-up, respectively, at the event held on April 19 at the Eko Convention Centre in Lagos. Meanwhile, Elizaveta Kuznetsova of Moldova won the overall Miss International 2026 crown, becoming the first contestant from her country to claim the title. Brittany Feeney of the United Kingdom finished as first runner-up, while Laura Glozarová of the Czech Republic came third. Victoria Kosasieputri of Indonesia and Khánh Như Lê of Vietnam completed the Top Five, finishing fourth and fifth, respectively. Bolarinde’s continental recognition marks another milestone in her pageant career and adds Nigeria to the list of countries represented among the award recipients at the international competition. The post Meet Nigeria’s Damilola Bolarinde, crowned Miss International Africa 2026 appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Cole Hutson Could Join His Brother in One of the NHL’s Most Exclusive Clubs
item.description: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Only four defensemen have led all NHL rookies in scoring over the course of a season since 1943-44. One of them was Lane Hutson, who recorded 66 points with the Montreal Canadiens in 2024-25. Just two seasons later, his younger brother has a legitimate opportunity to become the fifth. Cole Hutson took over the NHL rookie scoring lead after recording three assists in the Washington Capitals’ 7-4 loss to the New Jersey Devils on Nov. 14. At the time, Hutson was the only defenseman among the league’s top 13 rookie scorers. The 20-year-old has since been overtaken by some of the young forwards having incredible rookie seasons of their own, but he scored his sixth goal of the season in Wednesday’s 7-3 victory over the Philadelphia Flyers, bringing him up to 16 points in 22 games and within four points of rookie scoring leader Roman Kantserov. Considering some of the talent that entered the league this season, the fact that we’re even having this conversation about Hutson is pretty remarkable. Cole Hutson Could Join Some Incredible Company Bobby Orr became the first defenseman in the NHL’s modern era to lead all rookies in scoring, recording 41 points with the Boston Bruins in 1966-67. It took another 22 years for a defenseman to accomplish the feat, with Brian Leetch recording 71 points for the New York Rangers in 1988-89. Quinn Hughes became the third with 53 points for the Vancouver Canucks in 2019-20 before Lane joined the group with his incredible rookie season in Montreal. Cole is currently scoring at a rate that would see him finish with roughly 61 points over an 84-game season. It would be an incredible accomplishment on its own, but imagine both Hutson brothers leading their respective rookie classes in scoring just two years apart. Neither was even selected in the first round of their draft. The Canadiens selected Lane 62nd overall in 2022, while the Capitals selected Cole 43rd overall in 2024. There are going to be plenty of conversations in the coming years about how so many teams managed to pass on both of them. The Capitals Are Giving Hutson an Opportunity To Thrive I wrote earlier this week about how the Capitals may have found a long-term defense partner for Hutson in Jack St. Ivany . At the time, St. Ivany had spent more than 77% of his five-on-five ice time with Washington alongside Hutson, and what I’ve really liked about their partnership is how comfortable St. Ivany has been letting Hutson go to work offensively. Capitals head coach Spencer Carbery has spoken about St. Ivany’s ability to recognize when Hutson is getting involved offensively and adjust his positioning accordingly. When you’ve got a defenseman as talented and creative as Hutson, finding him a partner who understands how to play off him can go a long way toward getting the most out of his abilities. Washington gave up nothing to acquire St. Ivany off waivers, and it appears to have found someone who complements one of its most importan

item.title: McCord Needs Run Game Help Against Jets On Sunday
item.description: Credit: Mark Konezny-Imagn Images Kyle McCord has a chance to reset his rookie season, but the path forward is narrow. The Miami Dolphins face the New York Jets on Sunday, Nov. 29, at Hard Rock Stadium. McCord just endured a brutal outing against the Bills, completing only 12 of 33 passes for 102 yards. He also threw an interception and took eight hits while getting sacked twice. That performance highlighted a team that has lost four straight games since its lone win. The Dolphins need a better plan than just hoping the quarterback improves on his own. The offense has stalled because the run game has disappeared. Since beating the Jets on Oct. 25, Miami has failed to rush for 100 yards in any single game. This offensive drought lines up perfectly with the current four-game losing streak. McCord does not need to be a hero to give the team a chance. He simply needs protection and a running back who can move the pile. If the Dolphins cannot run the football, the rookie could face another long afternoon against a defense that will be ready. Jets Know How to Hurt a Quarterback The New York Jets remember their first meeting well, even though they lost that day. In Week 7, Miami built a 21-7 lead and held on for a 28-25 victory. In the first half, the Jets recorded 114 yards while the Dolphins amassed 231 total net yards. They also owned the clock with 21:09 of possession compared to just 8:51 for New York. Jets head coach Aaron Glenn admitted the difficulty of that start. “They punched us in the mouth in the first quarter,” HC Aaron Glenn said. That lesson sticks with a team that now sits at 3-8. Geno Smith and his offense are trying to fix their issues after a solid win against the Chargers. During his most recent start, Smith completed 17-of-21 passes for 176 yards and 3 TDs. He led long scoring drives and scored points on 5 of 6 possessions. The Jets want to start fast this time, especially since Smith grew up near the stadium. According to “We want to start fast first and foremost,”, Smith, a Miramar, FL native, grew up roughly 20 minutes away from Hard Rock Stadium. The Dolphins cannot afford to let the Jets control the game early. Practice Reps Build Confidence Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley believes the extra time in practice is helping McCord. The rookie has now started two games and faced different defenses in Indianapolis and Buffalo. Hafley sees the value in these reps as the team prepares for Sunday. “I think the reps that he’s getting in practice,” Hafley said. “The chemistry he’s developing with the guys, whether it’s the offensive line and the huddle, the wide receivers and the timing. I think that’s all going to be continued improvement.” The coach added that McCord is the type of guy who grows from both success and failure. The Dolphins are not asking McCord to reinvent the wheel or make impossible plays. They just need competent quarterback play and the ball to stay in his hands. item.title: Jason Kelce has perfect response to bizarre Mike McCarthy ice cream sandwich revelation
item.description: Photo by Scott Taetsch/Getty Images Jason Kelce has shared a hilarious reaction to reports that Pittsburgh Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy has a personal assistant who brings him ice cream sandwiches on demand. The former Philadelphia Eagles center shared a picture of the frozen treat on social media, seemingly showing his support for McCarthy’s unusual arrangement. The bizarre story emerged amid the messy fallout between McCarthy and Aaron Rodgers, who Pittsburgh officially released on Wednesday. Former Steelers defensive tackle Breiden Fehoko, who played for the team in 2023, then revealed that a player told him McCarthy had someone who delivers ice cream sandwiches. “Text from a Pittsburgh Steelers player just now: ‘McCarthy has a personal assistant who brings him ice cream sandwiches on demand’,” Fehoko posted. His revelation quickly caught the attention of NFL fans, but reporter Jordan Schultz decided to investigate the claims himself. “I asked several Steelers players if Mike McCarthy really does have an ice cream sandwich assistant, and they all confirmed: yes, it’s true,” Schultz revealed. The reporter’s findings suggested the rumour was not simply a joke circulating online. Kelce was among those who could not resist reacting to the revelation. The former Eagles star posted a picture of an ice cream sandwich on X alongside a short but brilliant caption. “I just want to say… I get it,” Kelce wrote. While Rodgers’ departure and his public disagreement with McCarthy have dominated NFL headlines, the Steelers head coach’s alleged ice cream arrangement has provided an unexpected distraction. Although it is hardly a major issue in isolation, it adds to growing concerns about McCarthy’s professionalism . item.title: Stale links on UK public sector websites direct visitors to gambling dens
item.description: UK public sector websites are directing visitors to gambling promotions through old links to defunct local enterprise partnerships (LEPs), research by digital consultancy Digital Royalty has found. The consultancy identified 93 links across 79 pages on websites belonging to 26 public bodies. LEPs brought together councils and businesses to promote economic growth in England under a coalition government initiative launched in 2010. Central government funding ended in April 2024, with their core functions transferred to local and combined authorities. Among other things, Digital Royalty builds and looks after websites, which means chasing down old links. In August, it found that a link on Surrey County Council's website led to a former LEP address now displaying casino content. It went looking for more. Digital Royalty founder Alex De Sousa said: "Slow is usually a sign of caution and diligence, but 31 months after the LEPs wound up, it's crossed into inefficient and dangerous." The consultancy offered The Register four examples of websites run by the Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport (DCMS), Hull City Council, Parliament, and the Local Government Association. One example is a government page about the Digital Skills Partnership, originally published under an earlier incarnation of DCMS. The page includes a link that appears to be for the Humber Digital Skills Partnership within the Humber LEP website, but in fact takes users to a site advertising "Independent Non GamStop Casinos UK – New Casino Sites Outside GamStop." GamStop is the self-exclusion scheme designed to help people restrict their online gambling, which makes the links more concerning than ordinary website clutter. The same link appears on the Hull City Council website under a list of Joint Committees, Partnerships and Trusts where it appears as Local Economic Partnership (Humber LEP). An old page for the Parliament website detailing the Department for Business, Energy & Industrial Strategy committee's Industrial Strategy report includes a footnote (135) that appears to be for the Business Central funding finder service, but takes the user to the "Highest RTP Non GamStop Casinos for UK Players." The Local Government Association's (LGA) sustainability and waste route map included a link to the former York and North Yorkshire LEP website. The destination initially appeared legitimate but contained links promoting crypto casinos. The LGA now appears to have removed the link. All the organizations mentioned have been contacted by The Register to offer them the opportunity to comment. Digital Royalty checked former web addresses associated with about 70 LEPs and growth hubs, then used a backlink index to identify roughly 3,000 incoming links from public sector sites. Most were simply outdated rather than leading to gambling content. The findings are not exhaustive: the index may miss pages, and the research did not cover other types of defunct public body whose domains may ha

item.title: Everything went wrong for the Packers on Thanksgiving Eve — and their season could be over
item.description: The Rams destroyed the Packers Micah Parsons is back and he didn’t love what he saw from the Packers. After his first game this season returning from a torn ACL, Parsons blasted Green Bay’s effort in a crucial 26-13 loss that put its playoff hopes in peril. “We need to figure out who’s going to be a dog or not,” Parsons said after the game, according to ESPN.com. “Like that’s just the reality of it. To me, to be honest and this is around the league, if someone can line up 50 times and run down your mouth and you don’t have an answer for it, that is player … that’s accountability. That’s just how I really feel about it.” Byron Young of the Los Angeles Rams celebrates after sacking Green Bay Packers quarterback Jordan Love on Wednesday, Nov. 25, 2026, in Inglewood, Calif. Getty Images The Rams racked up 246 yards on the ground — led by 184 from Blake Corum — to neutralize Parsons’ pass-rushing abilities and control the Thanksgiving Eve game. Parsons only played 26 of 71 snaps on defense with the Rams staying out of third-and-long situations where his pass-rushing ability has the chance to ruin a game. “I wasn’t able to get on the field because of it, because they didn’t want to waste my plays on first and second down,” Parsons said. “I think the whole thing is just bad and we’ve got to figure out who’s willing to play with us or who’s playing against us at this point because every quarter, every minute, every down matters and we’ve got to figure out who’s in this for the long haul and who’s in it for the ride.” Micah Parsons of the Green Bay Packers warms up prior to a game against the Los Angeles Rams in Inglewood, Calif., Wednesday, Nov. 25, 2026. Getty Images It was a pivotal game between two 6-4 teams fighting for one of the final playoff spots in the highly competitive NFC. The Packers looked like a team on the rise and a legitimate Super Bowl contender just two weeks ago when they thrashed the Patriots 45-27 in New England. But after two straight losses, including a 30-10 beatdown by the rival Vikings, the Packers now face an uphill road to make the postseason. It could even be more challenging with oft-injured star receiver Christian Watson leaving the game with a concussion after a vicious hit from Rams safety Kam Kitchens in the second quarter. The Packers offense sputtered without Watson, getting outscored 13-0 in the second half while only running 16 total plays. The four second half possessions alternated between three-and-outs and Jordan Love interceptions. Christian Watson of the Green Bay Packers is examined on the sideline during a game against the Los Angeles Rams in Inglewood, Calif., Wednesday, Nov. 25, 2026. Getty Images “This hole is massive,” Parsons, who did have a sack in his return, said. “We took a big swing and we missed ginormously. The only way to get out is, we probably have to win out. That’s just the reality of this situation. I think the people know that. We know that. From player to coach, we have to play better. I

item.title: Wild NHL fight goes on forever — and teammates’ reaction says it all
item.description: Tyrel Bauer #77 of the Winnipeg Jets and Tanner Jeannot #84 of the Boston Bruins fight during a game at TD Garden in Boston, Wednesday, Nov. 25, 2026. BOSTON — Boston’s Tanner Jeannot and Winnipeg’s Tyrel Bauer squared off at center ice in the first period on Wednesday night and put on one of the longest fights seen in the NHL in a while. The 6-foot-3 Bauer and the 6-2 Jeannot dropped the gloves near the center circle, then circled for about 20 seconds, looking for the right moment to make their move, before throwing more than 40 punches over nearly a minute in the Jets’ 4-2 victory over the Bruins. Not every punch landed, but Bauer’s helmet was knocked off, Jeannot got spun around, and when it was over and they were in the penalty box, both benches emptied, and the players went over to fist pound their respective teammates. Tyrel Bauer #77 of the Winnipeg Jets and Tanner Jeannot #84 of the Boston Bruins fight during a game at TD Garden in Boston, Wednesday, Nov. 25, 2026. NHLI via Getty Images “One of the best fights I’ve seen,” said Bruins second-year coach Marco Sturm, who played in the NHL for 14 seasons. “Jeano, holy moly,” Sturm said. “Unbelievable.” Jeannot and Bauer were seen on the ice talking during warmups and, likely, planned to square off. Talk about letting the boys go What a fight pic.twitter.com/ZPDZTDuD5G — Barstool Sports (@barstoolsports) November 26, 2026 They earned the respect of their teammates by trying to boost the energy for their respective teams. “That’s just two really tough customers,” said Jets center Morgan Barron, who scored a second-period go-ahead goal. “You see Tyrel in those fights, he stands in there as long as the other guy is willing to. I think it was just great, it got the guys some energy. That’s a really difficult job to do.” The Bruins felt the same way. “It’s unbelievable,’’ said Boston center Fraser Minten of Jeannot. “He’s like the nicest guy, an unbelievable teammate. Just an absolute warrior out there.” The Boston Bruins bench looks on as a first-period fight between Tyrel Bauer and Tanner Jeannot on Wednesday, Nov. 25, 2026, at TD Garden in Boston. NHLI via Getty Images Sturm has certainly seen his share of “tough guys” or what the league used to call “enforcers,” but he has great respect for what the two had to do. “I came in as young kid in this league and all the fights were pretty much open and you just go,” he said. “There was no defense, no structure. You just: ‘Go, Go.’ “That was wild,” he said. “In today’s world, there’s a lot of technique. … In today’s game, I think Jeano is elite and he showed it today.”

item.title: Where RBL currently stand in the race for the UCL play-offs
item.description: Where RBL currently stand in the race for the UCL play-offs Following our 3-1 win over RC Lens , the Red Bulls now sit 23rd in the table , putting us in a play-off spot. There are three games left in the Champions League league phase, and we're determined to pick up as many points as possible ! “ Every game is important now , which is why today's win was so valuable. We've still got a few games to play and we want to try and pick up as many points as possible. Every point counts ,” Antonio Nusa said afterwards. Manchester United clash could prove pivotal for RBL Automatic qualification for the Champions League round of 16 still looks some way off, with four points separating us from eighth-placed Manchester City . Having already faced two of the competition's strongest sides in Real Madrid and Manchester City during the first half of the league phase, we've got three challenging but winnable games ahead of us . A win away at Manchester United in two weeks' time would see us leapfrog the Red Devils, who currently sit 19th with seven points. United drew 2-2 with Sporting CP on matchday 5 under new head coach Mauricio Pochettino . It's been a difficult season for the English side, who currently sit second from bottom in the Premier League . Our two remaining opponents, Shakhtar Donetsk (26th) and Feyenoord (32nd), are both below us in the standings. They suffered 1-0 defeats to Fenerbahçe and Porto respectively. “We'll go to Manchester full of belief” RBL are off to the iconic Old Trafford on 8th December, where we've got some unfinished business. We suffered a 5-0 defeat in Manchester back in 2020, but won the reverse fixture 3-2 at the Red Bull Arena . “We've been making good progress as a team for several weeks now. We'll go to Manchester full of belief and try to get all three points. It won't be easy, but we'll be ready and we'll fight ,” said Martín Demichelis . Nine points were enough to secure a play-off spot last season, while 11 were needed in 2024/25 , the first season under the new league phase format. We missed out on the knockout stages that year, finishing with just three points. With three games and nine points up for grabs, the Red Bulls have one clear goal : reaching the Champions League round of 16 for the first time since 2023/24. item.title: Real Madrid superstar equals Ferenc Puskas’ record with goal against PSV
item.description: Real Madrid superstar equals Ferenc Puskas’ record with goal against PSV Real Madrid staged an excellent second-half comeback to secure a 5-1 win over PSV Eindhoven in the UEFA Champions League this midweek. Kylian Mbappe scored a brace and was subsequently nominated for the UCL Player of the Week . But the Frenchman had actually gifted his MOTM award to Vinicius Jr. It was an important game for the Brazilian international, who scored for Real Madrid for the first time in three months. In doing so, he has achieved a key milestone. Vinicius Jr. levels Puskas’ record Thanks to his late goal against PSV, Vinicius has now netted his 35th goal for Real Madrid in the Champions League, drawing him level with club legend Ferenc Puskas, reports Defensa Central . It was a special night for Vinicius. (Photo by Angel Martinez/Getty Images) Vinicius Jr. now stands fifth in the all-time list of goalscorers for Real Madrid in the competition, behind only an iconic quartet of Alfredo Di Stefano (49), Raul Gonzalez (66), Karim Benzema (78) and Cristiano Ronaldo (105). This is quite the achievement for a player who has been central to Real Madrid’s recent success and has already bagged two Champions League trophies. In the overall scheme of things, Vinicius currently sits 24th, just one goal behind Puskas. His teammate Kylian Mbappe is further ahead in fifth spot with 76 goals, but a majority of them came in PSG colours. A touching show of unity Apart from the milestone, it was a special goal for Vinicius in many ways, as the forward has been struggling with form throughout the entirety of the season so far. Vinicius Jr. has shown early signs of promise. (Photo by Denis Doyle/Getty Images) That is why the Real Madrid team showed exceptional unity when the Brazilian international did eventually find the back of the net, with Mbappe being at the heart of it. Despite being named the MOTM, the Frenchman handed the award to Vinicius, in a gesture of recognition for his efforts on the night. Vinicius Jr. himself was moved by the gesture and thanked his teammates after the game. “Very happy for how my teammates have celebrated a goal that I needed. We are a family. Thank you very much, really. I love you all, let’s go for more!” he wrote after the game. This chimes in well with reports that the entire Real Madrid team are now all in on helping Vini get back to his best.

item.title: Al-Nassr slam the door on Joao Felix's Barcelona return as Portuguese star agrees €12m salary hike and 2029 extension
item.description: Al Nassr v Neftchi Fargona - AFC Champions League Elite - Getty Images Sport Joao Felix appears set to remain in Saudi Arabia for the long term after Al-Nassr moved to activate a significant extension in his contract. Despite persistent links suggesting a potential return to Barcelona, the Portuguese international has reportedly given the green light to stay in Riyadh until 2029. Commitment to the Saudi project Al-Nassr have moved decisively to secure the long-term future of Felix, informing the forward of their decision to extend his stay in the Saudi Pro League through to 2029. During a recent high-level meeting between the club's sporting management and the player, the Riyadh-based outfit made it clear that they have no intention of selling the star or rescinding the extension clause in his current agreement. This development follows a period of heavy speculation regarding the 27-year-old’s next career move. According to Arriyadiyah , The former Atletico Madrid man has reportedly welcomed the proposal with open arms, expressing his immense satisfaction with life in Saudi Arabia. Felix highlighted the positive environment at Al-Nassr as a primary reason for his resurgence, which recently earned him a recall to the Portuguese national team starting line-up. His comfort in the city of Riyadh and his strong relationship with the club hierarchy played a pivotal role in the swift negotiations that have now paved the way for his continued presence in the Middle East. Under the terms of this new arrangement, Felix is set to see his annual earnings jump significantly to approximately €12 million. The contract also includes performance-based bonuses tied to the club’s success in domestic and continental competitions. Financial details and Chelsea payments The extension also triggers further financial obligations related to his original transfer from the Premier League. Chelsea are set to receive an additional €20 million as part of the overall transfer valuation, with Al-Nassr scheduled to pay half of that outstanding amount during the upcoming summer transfer window. The total cost of the deal is expected to reach €50 million now that the two-year extension has been confirmed. Previously, it was revealed that Al-Nassr held an automatic extension clause that could have been contested until the end of May. However, by reaching an early agreement with the player, the club has removed any uncertainty surrounding the June 1 deadline. Had the clause been rescinded, the total transfer value would have stood at just €30 million, but the club’s sporting department prioritized keeping the Portuguese playmaker over saving on the transfer fee. Barcelona return hopes dashed For Barcelona, this development represents a definitive end to their hopes of reuniting with a player who enjoyed a productive loan spell at the Estadi Olimpic Lluis Companys during the 2023-24 season. item.title: Five Heart Podcast: Thankful for Everything…Except Iowa
item.description: The Five Heart Podcast celebrates Thanksgiving Eve with a spirited edition of Iowa Hate Week! Greg, Minnie, and Fred revisit Nebraska’s thrilling 31–28 victory over Ohio State, discussing the Huskers’ resilience, improved offensive line play, and renewed commitment to running the football under Glenn Thomas. The crew examines Matt Rhule’s coaching decisions, Anthony Colandrea’s performance, and whether Nebraska can build on its signature victory heading into Friday’s rivalry showdown with Iowa. There’s plenty to celebrate beyond football, too! Nebraska volleyball captured the inaugural Big Ten Tournament championship with a sweep of Wisconsin, completing a remarkable 31–0 run heading into the NCAA Tournament. The conversation also covers Michigan’s athletic department turmoil, potential bowl destinations, and the importance of sustained success for Nebraska football. Naturally, Thanksgiving Eve brings plenty of whiskey, seasonal Shiner beers, outrageous Iowa jokes, and lively audience participation. The episode concludes with predictions for the Heroes Game, including Greg’s emphatic 24–10 Nebraska victory forecast and Fred’s reluctant decision to pick the Huskers. It’s nearly two and a half hours of football analysis, laughter, gratitude, and unfiltered Husker passion. Go Big Red!

item.title: Jose Alvarado stole the fourth for the Knicks
item.description: Nov 25, 2026; New York, New York, USA; New York Knicks guard Jose Alvarado (5) reacts after making a three point basket during the fourth quarter against the Cleveland Cavaliers at Madison Square Garden. Mandatory Credit: Vincent Carchietta-Imagn Images TPX IMAGES OF THE DAY Credit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect The Garden was waiting for Jalen Brunson to bail the Knicks out. Jose Alvarado beat him to it. The Knicks went into the fourth down 85-82 to Cleveland. Alvarado hit two straight threes to put New York up 90-85, and Pacome Dadiet scored twice on the break. By the time James Wiseman put in two baskets of his own it was 107-94. Those were not the guys you’d have picked before tipoff to get the Garden out of its seats with the Cup on the line. New York won 121-102 , its sixth straight. The fourth was 39-17, and Alvarado finished with a season-high 21. There are nights when the bench just tries to keep the game within reach for Brunson. This was a night when it handed him a lead. Nov 25, 2026; New York, New York, USA; New York Knicks guard Jose Alvarado (5) dribbles up court against the Cleveland Cavaliers during the second half at Madison Square Garden. Mandatory Credit: Vincent Carchietta-Imagn Images Credit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect The Knicks took the fourth quarter 39-17. Score progression from the NBA's official game summary. The Knicks didn’t need to take the ball back Here’s what I wouldn’t do: turn one night into a permanent fight over the backup point guard job. Brunson, who played after being listed with an illness, shot 6-for-22. Miles McBride and Jordan Clarkson didn’t play. That’s a specific set of circumstances, not a verdict on what Mike Brown’s rotation should look like in February. 0 What do you think? Post a comment. Still, there was no reason to take the game out of Alvarado’s hands as soon as the Knicks went ahead. I want Brown to keep that option when the offense needs some pace, especially after an empty few trips from the starters. The Knicks scored 20 fast-break points to Cleveland’s 11. The shooting was the loud part of the comeback, but they didn’t have to live on Alvarado making the next three. Philadelphia beat Miami earlier Wednesday , so the Heat didn’t clinch the group. They come to the Garden Friday . The Knicks will need more than a memorable night from Alvarado to make anything of the Cup. At least they get to play a Friday game that still matters. Related Headlines The Knicks are one loss from an early NBA Cup exit The Knicks can’t fake OG Anunoby’s size Andre Drummond can buy the Knicks extra shots without dragging everyone to the glass Read more at Empire Sports Media

item.title: James Jones says Aaron Rodgers’ rant on Pat McAfee’s show wasn’t even the most disappointing part
item.description: Photo by Joe Sargent/Getty Images Aaron Rodgers’ rant on the Pat McAfee show has shaken the NFL, but his former teammate James Jones is more disappointed by what happened on the show itself. The sanctity of the locker room was broken in astonishing fashion by Aaron Rodgers recently on the Pat McAfee show. Following his benching against the Denver Broncos, Rodgers went off on the Pittsburgh Steelers and head coach Mike McCarthy. What happened on the Pat McAfee show was hard to digest, but Rodgers’ former teammate, James Jones, is more disappointed by what happened around it. James Jones calls out AJ Hawk on Pat McAfee show Coincidentally, when Rodgers was going off on the Steelers and McCarthy, AJ Hawk was among the panellists on the Pat McAfee show. Hawk is a Super Bowl winner with the Green Bay Packers, played under McCarthy for nine years, and was also Rodgers’ teammate during that same span. Considering the statements Rodgers was saying with abandon on the show, James Jones felt disappointed that Hawk didn’t interrupt him once. Jones was a part of that same locker room, and hit back at Rodgers’ claim while speaking on Speakeasy . He said: “Coach Mike and Aaron have been with each other for almost 15 years, more than half of his career. And the most disappointing thing in this too on the Pat McAfee show is that AJ Hawk is sitting there. I don’t remember any of this at the Packers. “If you are from where I’m from, if I have a problem with you, I will call you and tell you that. I’m not going to go to the Pat McAfee show and downplay or talk badly about you.” Rodgers perhaps wouldn’t have expected the majority of the NFL ecosystem to side with McCarthy instead of him, but that is what the gravity of the situation is. The way he threw everyone under the bus at the Steelers after being benched was not very leader-like, and is especially not expected of a veteran of the game. Rodgers has probably ended his chances of landing with another NFL team after this. If that’s the case, it’s a sad end to one of the more illustrious careers in the league. item.title: MAC admits error on overturned Kent State touchdown that decided Eastern Michigan’s season finale
item.description: The Mid-American Conference said Wednesday that its replay official got the final play of the Kent State Golden Flashes’ season wrong, and that the touchdown wiped off the board in Tuesday night’s 17-12 loss to the Eastern Michigan Eagles should have counted. Kent State faced fourth-and-9 from the Eastern Michigan 14-yard line with six seconds left when Ethan Thanthanavong found Wayne Harris in the end zone. The officials on the field ruled it a touchdown, which would have put the Golden Flashes ahead in Ypsilanti. The replay review overturned it, ruling that Harris did not have firm control of the ball until his left foot was off the ground and that his right foot then landed out of bounds. The pass went down as incomplete, and Eastern Michigan held on. Samson Evans rushes for a big gain. Associated Press In its postgame evaluation, the league found that the video showed only slight movement of the football and did not establish that Harris lacked or lost control of it. “The video evidence did not meet the clear and obvious standard required to overturn the ruling on the field. The decision to overturn the touchdown was incorrect, and the original ruling should have been upheld,” the MAC said . The conference added that it regretted the effect the error had on the outcome. Kent State’s record still stands at 3-9 and 2-6 in MAC play, and the season is over, so the statement is all the Golden Flashes get for a catch the league now says was a game-winner. News: The MAC says Kent State’s game-winning touchdown at EMU last night should NOT have been overturned. https://t.co/F2GL5AjjrQ https://t.co/8S4AmmWbgF — Chris Vannini (@ChrisVannini) November 25, 2026 Eastern Michigan ended the Chris Creighton era the same day The statement landed hours after Eastern Michigan announced that it and Chris Creighton had parted ways after 13 seasons. The last win of his tenure is one his own conference has now said should have gone the other way. Creighton went 66-90 with the Eagles, and those 66 wins rank second in school history. He took Eastern Michigan to six bowl games, including three straight from 2021 to 2023, and his 2022 team went 9-4 and won the Famous Idaho Potato Bowl for the program’s first bowl victory since 1987. Every season since then has ended with a losing record. The disputed result did not move Eastern Michigan’s postseason status in either direction. At 5-7, the Eagles finished a win short of bowl eligibility, and a 4-8 finish would have left them in the same place. A touchdown on the final snap would have sent Kent State into the offseason with a conference road win. Harris’ catch instead stays in the books as an incomplete pass, and the final score in Ypsilanti remains 17-12, now with the league’s written acknowledgment that the first call on the field was right. item.title: Barcelona optimistic about veteran duo returning from injury against Deportivo – report
item.description: Barcelona optimistic about veteran duo returning from injury against Deportivo – report Barcelona are optimistic that Rodri and Andreas Christensen will be available for Sunday’s La Liga visit to Deportivo de A Coruna, with both players scheduled to undergo a final fitness test in Friday’s training session. According to Mundo Deportivo , the pair have made encouraging progress from their respective injuries, giving Hansi Flick the possibility of adding two more options to his squad for the match, which will be played on November 29. Mind you, neither return is confirmed, however, and Friday’s assessment will determine whether they are ready to be included. Rodri’s recovery offers Barcelona midfield boost Rodri is recovering from a minor injury to the biceps femoris in his right leg, sustained during Barcelona’s Champions League match against Aston Villa on November 3. The midfielder has been feeling positive about his recovery, and the aforementioned outlet believes he is likely to be available against Deportivo. Barcelona are optimistic that Rodri will play against Deportivo. (Picture credit: Barcelona official website) His return would be timely for Flick, as Rodri has missed important matches against Atletico Madrid, Villarreal and Sabah. The club will nevertheless need to assess his readiness and is expected not to rush him back. Even with a demanding run of fixtures approaching, a short appearance could help him regain match fitness ahead of more important games. Christensen also close to returning Meanwhile, Christensen has been s idelined by discomfort in his left calf , which ruled him out of Barcelona’s recent matches against Villarreal and Sabah. The Danish defender has also progressed well and will face the same final test as Rodri. Andreas Christensen did not play against Villarreal and Sabah. (Photo by Daniela Porcelli/Getty Images) His potential return would provide Flick with another option in central defence, an area where Barcelona have recently dealt with several fitness problems. Christensen’s availability could help reduce the need to rely on players covering unfamiliar positions during a congested schedule, such as Frenkie de Jong, who has played as centre-back against Villarreal and Sabah. Balde and Yamal remain part of the fitness picture Apart from Rodri and Christensen, Barcelona also need to monitor Alejandro Balde, who left the Sabah match with ankle discomfort after an impressive performance. His condition will be assessed following the injury in Baku. Lamine Yamal, meanwhile, did not travel to Azerbaijan because of a minor ankle issue but is expected to be available against Deportivo. As such, the squad did not train today as players recovered from the long journey back from Baku, meaning that Friday’s session will be important not only for Rodri and Christensen, but also for understanding the overall condition of the team.

item.title: Resurfaced clip of Mike McCarthy admitting to lying to secure Dallas Cowboys job goes viral
item.description: Photo by Tom Pennington/Getty Images Amid the controversy stirred up by Aaron Rodgers with his comments about Mike McCarthy, the former Dallas Cowboys’ head coach’s first day on the job is going viral. Following a 12-year stint with the Green Bay Packers, McCarthy had to wait two years before he got his next head coaching opportunity. But amid criticism of his coaching style and general honesty in dealings, McCarthy’s first comments upon becoming head coach of the Cowboys have started to go viral. Mike McCarthy openly admitted he lied to Jerry Jones about watching the Dallas Cowboys During his introductory press conference as the head coach of the Dallas Cowboys in 2020, Mike McCarthy revealed his negotiation tactics with Jerry Jones. McCarthy claimed that he had told Jones that he watched every snap the Cowboys played in the 2019 season, and then admitted he had told a lie just to secure the job, which elicited laughter from the whole room. “Well, I need to confess,” McCarthy started out. “I told Jerry that I watched every play of the 2019 season, but I wanted the job. I haven’t watched every play of the season, but you do what you gotta do, right?” Given the recent controversy surrounding Aaron Rodgers’ comments about McCarthy, this clip from over six years ago has now caught the eye of several fans. Many fans questioned how this wasn’t a more talked-about incident, given that McCarthy said that about the Dallas Cowboys, one of the NFL teams that draws a significant amount of media interest. However, others have pointed out that McCarthy was clearly joking. But even if he was, making such a joke during the most important press conference of your career is certainly a poor look. Regardless, this video resurfacing has shown just how much scrutiny McCarthy finds himself facing after Rodgers’ explosive interview. Smith shares why Mike McCarthy is in ‘trouble’ over Aaron Rodgers comments

item.title: Liverpool v Man Utd referee made ‘obvious error’ sending off Leny Yoro as written reasons published
item.description: Referee Sam Barrott made an “obvious error” by giving Manchester United defender Leny Yoro a red card against Liverpool, an independent regulatory commission unanimously concluded. Yoro was given his marching orders when he hauled down Swedish striker Alexander Isak in the opening stages of last Sunday’s fiery match at Anfield. Debate raged over Isak’s touch and whether goalkeeper Senne Lammens would have collected the ball had Yoro not made contact. Even referees’ chief Howard Webb concluded that the call was “certainly not clearly wrong”, but then Manchester United appealed to the Football Association for wrongful dismissal and successfully removed his one-match ban on Tuesday. Referee Sam Barrott made an “obvious error” in sending off Manchester United’s Leny Yoro at Liverpool, an independent commission unanimously concluded (Martin Rickett/PA) (PA Wire) The three-person panel’s written reasons were published on Thursday and stated: “The commission members were unanimous that, taking the foul committed by LY (Yoro) out of the scenario, AI (Isak) would not have had an obvious goalscoring opportunity. “Despite the fact that AI had reached the ball initially, his touch was heavy to the extent that he had in fact lost control of the ball – that control had, in effect, passed to the advancing MUFC goalkeeper who in the view of the commission would have been able to gather or smother the ball before AI could get to it and shoot at goal. “To the mind of the commission, the referee had made an ‘obvious error’ in deciding that AI (Isak) would have had an obvious goalscoring opportunity.” Webb, the chief refereeing officer at Pro Ref, told the Match Officials: Mic’d Up programme which aired on Tuesday, shortly after confirmation the ban had been removed: “There’s a question mark I guess around whether or not he (Isak) would get onto that ball before Lammens. Now, in the moment, the referee looked at it and felt he would. “The VAR checks to see whether that decision made on the field was clearly and obviously incorrect, and formed the opinion that it wasn’t. “I think by and large, most people would see that as a correct decision, with Isak moving quickly on towards that ball. The alternative view is that Lammens might get there first, but I think it’s a little bit debatable. (It’s) certainly not clearly wrong.” (Getty) The FA’s independent panel, which was made up of former Blackburn and Middlesbrough winger Stuart Ripley, former Sheffield United and Notts County forward Tony Agana and ex-Walsall goalkeeper Mick Kearns, disagreed. The reasons confirm that United submitted technical information to the panel which concluded Isak would have been, at best, 1.8 metres short of the ball even if Yoro had not made the challenge. The reasons state that the commission “had no way of testing the validity of this analysis undertaken by the club and as such the evidence was viewed with caution and allocated weight accordingly”. item.title: Liberty enters final week with NCAA probation after tampering case involving three staffers
item.description: The NCAA’s Division I Committee on Infractions released its decision in the Liberty Flames’ tampering case on Tuesday, putting the No. 21 program on probation as it heads into the final week of a 10-1 regular season. Assistant coaches Newland Isaac and Tony Washington and director of player personnel Colton Korn had impermissible contact with two players, and with representatives for those players, while the athletes were enrolled at another NCAA school and had not entered the transfer portal. The Associated Press identified that school as the Monmouth Hawks. Neither player ended up transferring to Liberty. Liberty, the three staffers and the NCAA enforcement staff agreed on the violations and penalties through the negotiated resolution process, and a hearing panel signed off on the deal. The school receives one year of probation and a $25,000 fine , along with three-week bans on football recruiting communication and unofficial visits during the 2026-27 academic year. Dec 1, 2023; Lynchburg, VA, USA; Liberty Flames quarterback Kaidon Salter (7) holds up the Conference USA MVP trophy after the game against the New Mexico State Aggies at Williams Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Brian Bishop-USA TODAY Sports The program also loses 3% of its official visits, based on its average over the previous four years, and 5% of its permissible recruiting person days. Washington drew the heaviest individual penalty, a two-year show-cause order and a two-game suspension that he served on Sept. 5 and Sept. 12. Isaac and Korn each received a one-year show-cause order and a one-game suspension, served Sept. 5 against the James Madison Dukes. Head coach Jamey Chadwell was held responsible under the NCAA’s head coach responsibility rules, though the parties agreed he did not know about the contact, in part because of significant health issues, and did not condone it. He served a one-week ban on recruiting communication from Sept. 3 to Sept. 10. #BREAKING: Liberty will be ineligible for the 2026 CUSA Championship Game following NCAA recruiting tampering violations. Delaware at Jacksonville State is now the projected matchup, pending Week 13 results. https://t.co/xTM5iJxEt2 — TheCUSACentel (@TheCUSACentel) November 25, 2026 Liberty’s place in the CUSA title game holds The penalty list includes no postseason ban, and Liberty, 7-0 in Conference USA, has already clinched a spot in the conference championship game against the Jacksonville State Gamecocks, set for Friday, Dec. 4, at 6 p.m. ET on CBS Sports Network. The game will be played in either Lynchburg, Virginia, or Jacksonville, Alabama, depending on the final week of results. The Flames first close the regular season at the Missouri State Bears on Saturday at 2 p.m. ET. Liberty went 4-8 last fall, the program’s first losing record in 20 years, and this is its first trip to the CUSA title game since 2023, when the Flames beat the New Mexico State Aggies and went on to the Fiesta Bowl.
